key_theses.title: Bitcoin Has Likely Bottomed (or Is Bottoming)
supporting_points: 50% drawdown vs 80%+ historical = structurally different cycle
Institutional absorption: Middle East sovereign funds, public company treasuries (MSTR, ProCap)
On-chain confirmation: STH-SOPR green, more underwater holders than profitable
Technical confluence: 200-week MA + RSI historic lows + capitulation metrics aligning

key_theses.title: Bitcoin Wins in BOTH Inflationary AND Deflationary Regimes
supporting_points: Innovation (AI) structurally deflationary → pushes short rates toward 0%
Fiscal response to deflation structurally inflationary → stimulus, bonus depreciation, high tax refunds
Result: Negative real yields (T-bill < CPI) = exact condition Bitcoin outperforms in
Bitcoin captures BOTH hard-asset inflation hedge bid AND long-duration growth bid fleeing software

key_theses.title: Agentic AI Hardware Shift Is the Real Trade
supporting_points: Inflection point: November 2025 (Opus 4.5 release = shift from reasoning → agentic models)
Agentic AI needs east-west traffic (memory, CPU, networking, power) not just north-south GPU compute
Bottleneck cascade: Memory (Micron) → CPUs → Optical fiber (Corning) → Packaging chemicals (US chem cos)
Automotive multiplier: AI-enabled vehicles = 3-4x semiconductor content per unit (Qualcomm beneficiary)
Cloud repatriation: Enterprises moving AI on-prem for privacy → Dell/HPE renaissance

key_theses.title: Public Equities Are Wrong Vehicle for AI Upside
supporting_points: Visser: "Public company shareholders will NOT be primary AI beneficiaries"
Winners = private AI-native startups (no legacy friction, no headcount bloat)
Financial infrastructure for startup value capture shifts to crypto rails (tokenization, stablecoins)
Software valuations broken: "When there's no terminal value, how do you value something?"

key_theses.title: Michael Saylor's Sale = Noise, Not Signal
supporting_points: Discussed at 33:33-38:02 (your timestamp 36:14 falls here)
Strategy (MSTR) sold $216M BTC; market panicked
Visser/Pomp view: Treasury management, not thesis change
ProCap (Pomp's firm) BOUGHT 450 BTC same quarter
Saylor remains "most convicted holder on earth" - sale was cost-basis optimization

key_theses.title: Macro Catalysts Ahead
supporting_points: Fed July rate decision (discussed at 42:04+)
Iran/geopolitical risk - "does it actually matter for markets?" (42:04)
PMI → CPI lag: Visser forecasts CPI >4% within 3 months (freight data, commodity bull market, memory/CPU shortages)
Housing & wages NOT improving - Visser separates these from PMI-based inflation call

key_theses.title: Five Scarcity Baskets Portfolio Framework
supporting_points: 1. Memory & Compute (Micron, CPU makers)
2. Networking/Optical (Corning, fiber)
3. Chemicals/Packaging (US chem cos w/ natgas advantage)
4. Automotive AI (Qualcomm, semi content multiplier)
5. On-Prem Infrastructure (Dell, HPE, legacy server names)
